translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Guyau Debida litula
Matausina Debida litula eikaloubusi tutala igau eisisu mapilana Ebironi.

content.text: Aminoni inala yagala Ainowam minana vilela Yesireeli
Daniela, inala yagala Abigeili minana vilela Kamela
Abisalom inala yagala Maaka, minana tamala Talimai guyoula Gesura

content: Ola tuta Debida eiguyoi Ebironi kala taitu iboda kwailima kwaiyu kabulotala e magudisina litula tailima taitala eiuni wa tuta matutona. E matauna iguguyau Yerusalem kala taitu ibodi kweluwotolu kwaitolu,
e litula bidubadu ikaloubusisi baisa. E la kwava Batiseba, minana Amiela latula, iuni litula taivasi. Simea, Sobabi, Netani, deli Solomoni.
Matauna litula tuvaila kasi bawa tailima taivasi Iba, Elisuwa, Elipeleti,
Noga, Nepegi, Yapia,
Elisama, Eliada, Elipeleti.
Debida la ula minasina eivigaki makawala la kukova tuvaila iunaisi litusia, baisa katumkulovala kala kakalawa komwaidona litula tauwau. Matauna tuvaila natana latula vivila yagala Tamara.
Guyau Solomoni dalela
Baisa makawala guyau Solomoni dalela, eivitouula tumisia bisaitaula goli bila litula. Solomoni, Rioboam, Abia, Asa, Yeosepata,
Yeoram, Eyasaia, Yowasi,
Amasaia, Usaia, Yotam,
Eyasi, Esekaia, Manasa,
Amona, Yosaia.
Yosaia litula taivasi, Yowanani, Yeoyakim, Sedakaia, Yowaasa.
Yeoyakim litula taiyu, Yeoyakini deli Sedekaia.
Guyau Yeoyakini dalela
Baisa makawala Guyau Yeoyakini dalela, matauna leikatupipaisi mina Babilonia. E Yeoyakini litula tailima taiyu, Sealitieli,
Malikiram, Pedaia, Senasa, Yekamia, Osama, deli Nedabia.
Pedaia litula kasitaiyu Serubabela sola Simei. E Serubabela litula kasitaiyu, Mesulam sola Ananaia, deli natana latula vivila yagala Selomiti.
Matauna tuvaila litula kasi bawa tailima. Asuba, Oweli, Berekia, Asadia, deli Yusabi Esedi.
Ananaia litula taiyu, Pelatia sola Yesaia. Yesaia latula Repaia, Repaia latula Anani, Anani latula Obedaia, Obedaia latula Sekanaia.
Sekanaia latula taitala wala Semaia, e tubula tailima. Atusi, Igali, Baria, Nearia, deli Sapati.
Nearia litula taitolu. Eliowenai, Isikaia, Asirikam.
Eliowenai litula tailima taiyu Odavia, Eliasibi, Pelaia, Akubi, Yowanani, Delaia, deli Anani.
